_comment: Circuit breaker defaults (spec Section 5.1). A breaker = (unit, window, max-events, trip-action). Every ceiling is a SAFETY CAP under Skill 60 Signal S4's law: a raise without an operator approval stamp is a P1; the system never silently raises its own limits. Overridable per box, but a loosened ceiling without a stamp is itself a P1.

process.watches: D1 restart velocity per supervised unit
process.note: STOP + park the unit (supervisor-native: max-restarts + exponential backoff restart delay) + P1 with last boot-log excerpt. A parked unit is visible-red until fixed; it never silently respawns. Feeds LP-B1/LP-B2 (LF-6).

turn.note: Heartbeat allowlist enforcement + offending cron parked + P1. NEVER touches the client's model choice (sovereignty) - it parks TIMERS, not models. Feeds LP-A2 (LF-8).

retry.note: Job parked in a resumable state + Rescue Rangers escalation (the auto-redispatch doctrine's own step 4: escalate after K tries, never tight-loop). Feeds LP-A4.

cron.note: Cron disabled (not deleted) + P1 with the cron id and its declared-vs-actual cadence. Feeds LP-A6/LP-C2/LP-D3 (LF-4).

session.watches: D5 runtime tool-loop blocks per session transcript
session.note: ARCHIVE (move aside) the poisoned transcript so the next turn starts clean, then P1. DISABLE-NEVER-DELETE applies in full: the transcript is MOVED to a timestamped archive name and the one-line revert moves it back - a session is never deleted. Refuses to touch a session whose file is still being written (the live-session guard, roll_min_idle_minutes): a burning session gets the P1 + the prepared abort, never a file yanked from under a running gateway. Feeds LP-A8 (LF-10). NOTE: the poisoned COMPACTION CHECKPOINTS survive this roll and need LF-11, which is Tier 2 (prepare-only) because the live gateway rewrites the session store.
session._source: max_blocks_per_burst mirrors thresholds.d5_transcript_poison.p1_blocks_per_burst (smallest burst measured in the archived incident: 8).

healer.watches: the watchdog's OWN fix actions per target
healer.note: The session-health.sh lesson encoded: a healer that loops is disabled by its OWN breaker, never by discovering the damage later. > 3 fixes on the same target / 24h OR any fix-verify failure = STOP fixing that target, flag healer-loop-suspected, escalate.

resend.watches: D7 cross-run identical-payload resend count per (source,target,payload) triple
resend.note: The 2026-08-04 incident: a sessions_send caller that omitted timeoutSeconds hit the tool's hardcoded 30000ms fallback, misread the local timeout as a delivery failure, and resent the byte-identical message as a brand-new top-level run 6-8x, ~34s apart - each resend a FRESH run id, so OpenClaw's own tools.loopDetection (within-run) and session.agentToAgent.maxPingPongTurns (inner ping-pong of one sessions_send call) both reset every time and never fired. Aborts the SOURCE session's in-flight run via the native sessions.abort RPC (calling it with no active run is a documented safe no-op: ok=true, abortedRunId=null, status='no-active-run') - NEVER pkill node, NEVER a gateway restart - then parks the source unit visible-red so it cannot immediately re-fire; an operator unpark lifts the pause. action_cooldown_seconds bounds how often the breaker may re-fire on the SAME source. Feeds LP-A10 (LF-12).
